B52.title: Block close gate hardening (issue #2 field note: a block closed with open criticals): the file set is the diff since base plus every file with a review row of the block, matched against owned paths including directories; an approval is stale after a later non-approved review of the same content; not_approved per open finding (a critical needs a human waiver); old-ledger rows judged by the signed result file; no_changes for an empty set; unowned_change for files changed after open outside owned paths (tree_at_open stamps); triage never demotes a critical; --no-require-reviews needs the owner at a terminal

B53.title: Clean-pass token floor for any diff size (issue #6): a structured clean pass (passed: true, no findings, hunks acknowledged in order, a non-blank summary) needs min(review.min_tokens_out, 40) output tokens; any finding, passed: false or a blank summary keeps the full floor

B54.title: Long documents get reviewed (issue #2): review.budgets.full_in defaults to 32000; a Markdown file whose diff is still over the budget is reviewed section by section (hunks cut at headings outside fenced code and front matter, sections packed within the budget, every section packet built and checked before any session, approved only when every section is, findings as S<n>.<id>, rechecks sectioned the same way); a split_required result carries tokens_in, budget and section
B54.note: root-added 2026-10-08; GitHub issue #2 note of 2026-10-02 (25k-token brief never reviewed); also amends src/review/{packet,engine,fixloop}.mjs, src/worker/{engine,loop}.mjs, src/cli/{review,review-file}.mjs, schema/code-forge.schema.json, docs/reference/config.md, docs/how-it-works.md, skill/references/review.md

B55.title: Schema-miss fallback (issue #2): a review answer that fails the schema twice on the same packet (same run, file, content, packet text, level and role) is retried once on review.second_levels.<level> (its ladder minus the failed model and, for closed-book roles, minus Codex unless allowed) behind a signed review.schema_fallback row written before the spawn; never in consensus mode; tokens of both sessions summed; every miss logs a structural diagnosis (review.schema_invalid: bytes, kind, keys and types, schema errors, never the text); the autopilot binnacle shows each fallback
B55.note: root-added 2026-10-08; GitHub issue #2 note of 2026-10-06; also amends src/review/{engine,fixloop,validate-review}.mjs, src/worker/engine.mjs, src/session/spawn.mjs (stderr tail moved to util), src/autopilot/binnacle.mjs, test fakes, docs/how-it-works.md, skill/references/review.md

B56.title: Moved-code hint (issue #2): code moved between changed files of the same block is detected by deterministic line matching (>= 3 significant lines or >= 120 significant characters; peers in the base diffed against it, deleted peers included) and named in a ## moved code packet section on both files, in round 1, rechecks, patch checks, the judge packet and per Markdown section; extra text only (every hunk and reviewed_hunks unchanged); counted in the packet budget with one measure; unsafe peer names never read or printed; peer diffs read once per ticket with a 2 MiB per-peer cap
B56.note: root-added 2026-10-08; GitHub issue #2 note of 2026-10-06 (stale critical from a cross-file move); also amends src/review/{packet,engine,fixloop,sections}.mjs, src/worker/engine.mjs, docs/how-it-works.md, skill/references/review.md
